description: These dependencies are updated as part of updating the copier template
A new services-template-helm release is never opened as a branch/PR
unattended: it changes files in every team's folders (see the
customManagers entry below), so it is listed on the Dependency
Dashboard for someone to tick before Renovate acts on it -- the cue
to run a 'Update a Services Repository Template' template update.
Generic IOC images are tagged either by date (e.g. 2026.9.1) or,
when built around one main support module, with that module's
version plus a build number (e.g. R2-3ec2), optionally with a
'-beta.N' / '-alpha.N' / '-rc.N' prerelease suffix (see 'Update
Generic IOC Image Versions'). A generic IOC's tag history can carry
older, differently-shaped tags (a 'v' prefix, a dot instead of a
hyphen before 'beta'); restrict proposals to the two current shapes
so Renovate never offers one of those instead.
NOT independently verified against a live generic-IOC repo's full
tag list -- check this regex against one before relying on it.
Track vendored runtime-support pattern libraries pinned in each
IOC instance's runtime-lock.yaml so Renovate raises a PR when a new
library release (git tag) is available.
NOTE: after a bump CI / the maintainer MUST re-run
'ibek pattern update' to re-vendor the files and refresh the hashes
in runtime-lock.yaml (Renovate only edits the version string here).
Track the copier template version pinned in .copier-answers.yml so
a new services-template-helm release appears on the Dependency
Dashboard (see the dependencyDashboardApproval packageRule above).
